desc: The Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 at the registered office of the Company which commenced at 11:00 A.M. and concluded at 11:30 A.M., inter alia approved the allotment of 72,04,099  Equity Shares of the Company of face value of Rs. 2/- each, at a premium of Rs. 13.10/-  per share, pursuant to the exercise and conversion of 72,04,099  convertible warrants against receipt of the balance subscription amount of Rs. 11.325/- per warrant (i.e. 75% of the issue price)
Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to the exercise and conversion of Convertible Warrants
Notice of 35th AGM of the Company to be held on 23 September, 2026.
Letter providing the web link for accessing the Annual Report dispatched to Shareholders.
Newspaper Notice of 35th Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on September 23, 2026
The Exchange has received the disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 for Panna Lal Baid & Others
Certificate from Statutory Auditor in terms of Regulation 169 (5) of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 ("ICDR Regulations")
